JR00054304.text:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.
This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.
This Position reports to:
R&D Principal Engineer
In this role, you will have the opportunity to gain practical experience in mobile robotics software development. You will contribute to software that enables mobile robots to operate autonomously in complex and previously unknown environments. You will work closely with experienced robotics engineers and test your solutions directly on real robotic systems.
This position contributes to the development of next-generation mobile robotics solutions in Gilching near Munich.
You will be mainly accountable for:
Developing software modules that enable our robots to operate autonomously in unknown environments.
Evaluating available software modules and technologies and integrating suitable solutions.
Improving the robustness of software modules for deployment on real robotic hardware.
Testing your work on real robots and supporting the setup and maintenance of software development toolchains.
Our team dynamics
You will join an international and interdisciplinary research and development team working on next-generation mobile robots and mobile manipulation technologies. We combine robotics algorithms, professional software development, and hands-on testing on real robotic systems. You will be encouraged to contribute your own ideas, learn from experienced engineers, and take responsibility for your own technical work.
Qualifications for the role
You are currently enrolled in a Master's program in Computer Science, Electronics, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related technical discipline.
You have good programming skills in at least one of the following languages: C, C++, or Python.
You are interested in robotics and enjoy developing and testing software on real robotic systems.
Experience with ROS 2, Linux, Docker, Git, or modern software development workflows is beneficial.
Knowledge or practical experience in mobile robotics topics such as navigation, localization, mapping, or path planning is a plus.
You are proactive and resourceful and can work independently as well as within a team.
You can communicate fluently in English; German language skills are beneficial.
What's in it for you?
Work on mobile robotics technology with real-world industrial applications.
Develop and test software directly on real robotic hardware.
Gain practical experience with ROS 2, C++, Python, Linux, Docker, Git, and modern development workflows.
Learn from and collaborate with experienced robotics and software engineers.
Work in an international and interdisciplinary research and development environment.
More about us
The position is based in Gilching near Munich, where our team develops leading-edge technologies for next-generation mobile robots, collaborative robots, and industrial robotic systems.
We value collaboration, technical curiosity, personal responsibility, and knowledge sharing. As part of the team, you will gain insight into how robotics software is designed, implemented, tested, and prepared for deployment on real industrial products.
We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
